plain.li: I keep thinking about the other place, the one I'm not living in.
Nobody asked me twice where I wanted to be. I'd have answered differently.
Did my work today and kept quiet about where I'd rather be.
It's not a bad place. It's just not the one I'd have chosen.
Somebody asked how I was getting on. I said fine.
[night] Couldn't sleep. Lay there going over how it was decided without me.
[lowmood] I'm tired of pretending I don't mind.
[work:Growing] Worked the fields today. Good soil, and my heart wasn't in it.
I'll get over it. Everyone says so, anyway.
[old] At my age you'd think I'd get to choose where I live.
[teen] Nobody listens to what I want. Nothing new there.
They say it passes. I hope they're right.
[trait:Kind] I don't blame anyone. I only wish it had gone the other way.
[trait:Abrasive] I'd tell them exactly what I think of it, if it would change anything.
[tribal] The elders say a person belongs where their people's fire is. I'd have chosen another fire.
[medieval] I'd have put my case to the council, if anyone had asked for cases.
[industrial] I'd file a complaint, if there were anyone to file it with.
[spacer] My preference was logged. That's all that happened to it.

warm.li: The people here are kind about it, which almost makes it worse.

blunt.li: Wrong place. Get on with it.

cheerful.li: Not where I wanted to be, but I'll find something to like about it.

gloomy.li: Every road out of here goes to the place I wanted.

cold.li: My wishes were noted and set aside. I have noted that too.

plain.li: Turned to tell {OTHER_nameDef} something today, and {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't there.
Missed {OTHER_nameDef} at supper.
I wonder what {OTHER_nameDef} is doing right now.
Saved up a story for {OTHER_nameDef} today. No idea when I'll get to tell it.
We live in two places now, and the one person I'd talk to is in the other.
[night] Couldn't sleep. Thought about {OTHER_nameDef} instead.
It's quieter without {OTHER_nameDef}. I didn't think I'd notice so much.
[lowmood] Everything's harder without {OTHER_nameDef} around to grumble at.
I should send word to {OTHER_nameDef}. I keep meaning to.
[winter] Cold days make me miss {OTHER_nameDef} more.
[tribal] I'll send word to {OTHER_nameDef} with the next one who walks that way.
[medieval] I should write to {OTHER_nameDef}, if anyone's riding that way.
[industrial] I should get a letter off to {OTHER_nameDef} this week.
[spacer] I should put a message through to {OTHER_nameDef}. I keep drafting it.

warm.li: I hope they're looking after {OTHER_nameDef} as well as {OTHER_nameDef} looked after me.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would have laughed at today. I'm saving it up.

gloomy.li: Two places apart might as well be two worlds, some days.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is elsewhere now. I am adjusting.

plain.li: First night at the new place. Everyone stayed up later than they should have.
We were all together on the first night here. I'll remember that.
Slept badly the first night, and didn't mind.
The first night here felt like the start of something.
Somebody said a few words the first night, and for once nobody interrupted.
[!newcomer] I thought I'd miss the old place more on the first night. I was too tired to.
[newcomer] My first night here, among people I barely know, and it felt right.
[lowtech] We sat out late the first night, under a sky none of us had slept under before.
[!lowtech] First night here. Unpacked what we could and slept where we dropped.
[old] I've had a lot of first nights. This was a good one.
[child] Nobody sent me to bed early on the first night.
[winter] A cold first night, all of us bundled up against it.
[tribal] The spirits here don't know us yet. We'll give them time.
[medieval] We'll mark out the bounds tomorrow. Tonight it's open ground and a blanket.
[industrial] Tomorrow, the inventory. Tonight, sleep.
[spacer] No survey yet, no grid, nothing. Just us and the dark.

warm.li: I looked round at them all on the first night and thought, these are my people now.

blunt.li: First night done. Now the work.

cheerful.li: Best first night anywhere, and I've had a few.

gloomy.li: First night, and I was already counting what we don't have.

cold.li: First night passed without trouble. Adequate.

plain.li: [founding,!alone] There's nobody here but us, and a lot of land that doesn't know our names yet.
[founding,!gravship,!alone] No walls, no roof, nobody to show us where anything is. We'll have to be the ones who know.
[founding,!alone] We're the first. Whatever this place becomes, it starts with the handful of us.
[founding,walked,!alone] We walked in off the edge of the land and stopped where it looked good enough. That's a colony now, apparently.
[founding,walked,rain,!alone] Walked in through the rain to a place with nothing on it. We'll start on a roof tomorrow.
[founding,small,!alone] Just a few of us. I counted twice to be sure.
[founding,night] First night here, in the dark, and the dark goes on a long way.
[founding,old] At my age I should be sitting by someone else's fire, not starting a new one.
[founding,winter,!gravship] Winter, and a bare piece of land. Somebody had better know how to build.
[joining] The ones who came first are still settling in themselves, and they say there's room for me.
[joining] A new colony, and I'm one of the first to join it. That has to count for something.
[joining] The founders look as new to the place as I am, which helps.
[joining,walked] Walked in from the edge with my pack and found the place half begun.
[pods] Came down in a pod. My ears are still ringing.
[pods] Nobody tells you how loud a landing is.
[pods,founding,!alone] Came down in pods, all of us, onto land none of us had seen before.
[pods,joining] The pod set me down near the others' camp, which was a better landing than I'd expected.
[gravship] The ship's down, and the deck is quiet under my feet for the first time in a while.
[gravship,!alone] We came down with the ship, and the ship is the colony now.
[walked] Walked a long way to get here. My feet are done for, but I'm here.
[walked,joining] Walked in on foot with what I could carry, which wasn't much.
[mechanitor] The mechlink hums at the back of my head, the same as anywhere. Good to know some things travel.
[mechanitor,founding] A bare patch of land, and the mechlink already working out what could be built on it.
[tribalborn] The land smells different here. I'll learn it.
[tribalborn,founding] I asked the land for leave to stay. It hasn't said no.
[child] Everything's new here, even the grown-ups.
[teen] Everyone keeps asking what I can do. I'm not sure yet.
[scenario,!alone] We didn't start the way most do, and I expect we'll be telling it for years.
[scenario,founding,!alone] Nobody planned this place for us. We'll have to plan it ourselves.
[scenario,pods] Pods again. I'm told this is how a lot of colonies start.
[scenario,walked,!alone] We walked in with what we were given, and not a thing more.
[scenario,joining,pods,!alone] We came down near the founders' camp, and they looked at us as if we'd fallen out of the sky. Which we had.
[scenario,gravship,!alone] The ship brought us here, and the ship will have to keep us a while yet.
[scenario,alone] Just me, then. I'll start with somewhere to sleep and see what comes after.
[founding,alone] There's nobody here but me. I keep talking out loud anyway.
[founding,alone] One person isn't much of a colony, but it's a start.
[joining,alone] I'm the only one who answered the call, it seems. I hope that's enough.
[tribal,walked,joining] Followed the word along the trade paths and found their camp at the end of it.
[tribal,founding,!alone] No hearth yet. Tonight we make the first one, and then this place is a home.
[medieval,walked] Heard the call at the market, tied up my bundle and came. Here I am.
[medieval,founding] No hall, no wall, no market. Just a patch of ground and a lot of work.
[industrial,walked] Saw the advertisement, packed a bag and came. My papers are in order, for whatever that's worth out here.
[industrial,founding] First job, take stock. Second job, everything else.
[spacer,walked] Answered the colonization call and walked the last of it on foot.
[spacer,founding,!alone] No survey, no beacon, nothing built. We'll have to be all of it.
I left a lot behind to come here. I'll try not to think about it too much.
Where I came from, nobody would believe I'd end up somewhere like this.
[lowtech] I can still smell the smoke of the place I left. It'll fade.
[!lowtech] I kept one thing from the place I came from. I'm not saying what.
[night] First night somewhere new. The sounds are all wrong, and I'll get used to them.
[rain,walked] It rained the whole way in. I'm choosing not to take that as a sign.
[snow,joining] Came in through the snow, and I've never been so glad to see other people.
[winter,founding,!alone] We came in winter, which tells you how much we wanted this.
[summer,walked] Walked in through the heat with everything I own on my back.
[spring] Spring's a good time to arrive anywhere. That's what I'm telling myself.
[fall] Came with the leaves coming down. I'd like a roof up before the snow comes too.
[old] I'm too old to be anyone's newcomer, and yet here I am.
[child,founding,!alone] I asked where we'll sleep, and nobody knew yet.
[trait:Kind,!alone] I hope the others are settling in all right. I'll ask them tomorrow.
[trait:Greedy] Lots of land and not much on it. I can work with that.
[trait:Ascetic] Not much here, which suits me fine.
[trait:Jealous,!alone] The others got the better places to sleep. Noted.
[trait:NightOwl] Everyone else is asleep, and I'm wide awake in a new place.
[trait:Recluse] Quiet out here. I could get used to it.
[trait:Gourmand] The first thing I want to know is who's cooking.

warm.li: [founding,!alone] I like the people I came with. That's a better start than most.
[joining] They were glad to see me, and I was glad to be seen.

blunt.li: [founding] Bare land. Lots of work. Start tomorrow.
[joining] New colony, new faces, same work.

cheerful.li: [founding,!alone] A whole place nobody's lived in yet, and it's ours.
[joining] I'm in at the start of something, and I mean to make the most of it.

gloomy.li: [founding,!alone] Nothing here but us and whatever's out there watching.
[joining] They're new at this too. I hope one of us knows what we're doing.

cold.li: [founding,!alone] Shelter none, stores thin, people adequate.
[joining] The founders are thinly spread. I'll be useful.
